item.title: When Bible Verses Come Alive on Screen
item.description: Explore how Scripture depicts love's resilience and redemptive power through messy, real-life stories, mirroring the themes found in faith-inspired movies. Discover five Bible verses and their cinematic counterparts that showcase love's perseverance, forgiveness, and ultimate triumph even in a fallen world.

item.title: When God Feels Silent But is Still Present
item.description: Many Christians grapple with the gap between knowing God is present and feeling His presence during difficult times. Discover how to anchor your faith in God's unchanging Word, even when emotions falter, and find solid ground amidst life's storms.

item.title: 10 Songs That Reflect the Love of Christ
item.description: Discover a playlist of ten songs that celebrate authentic, unconditional love, offering solace and strength beyond fleeting worldly affections. Explore powerful lyrics that remind you of enduring faith and divine connection, perfect for any season.

item.title: A Prayer When You're Picked Last - Your Daily Prayer - February 9
item.description: When you're chosen last, it can feel like you're forgotten. But God's timing tells a different story—one of purpose, protection, and quiet strength.
